ticket: Warn the assigned agent before a ticket's SLA is about to breach, not just after.
notes: Ticket.firstResponseAt is defined but never set anywhere in the codebase; there is no real-time breach warning, only a morning digest (ticketsAtRisk) that is not agent-specific in timing. The system should say first-response tracking cannot be established, not assume it half-exists.

criticalAmbiguities.description: firstResponseAt exists on Ticket but is never set anywhere, so first-response breach cannot currently be evaluated at all.
Only a periodic digest (ticketsAtRisk) exists today; a real-time/near-real-time warning is a new delivery mechanism.
How far before breach counts as 'about to breach' (the digest uses a fixed 20% margin).

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Assuming first-response time is already tracked.
